about.title: About Us
about.subtitle: We are a collective of creators, dreamers, and builders.
about.mission.title: Our Mission
about.mission.p1: Our aim is not making a profit. (At least not yet.)
about.mission.p2: Instead, we hope we can spread the love to the world and make everyone enjoy the fun of the Internet and technology. We believe in open source, collaboration, and building things that bring joy.
about.values.title: Our Values
about.values.love.title: Built with Love
about.values.love.desc: Every line of code is written with passion and care.
about.values.opensource.title: Open Source
about.values.opensource.desc: We believe in collaboration and sharing knowledge freely.
about.values.community.title: Community Driven
about.values.community.desc: Our users inspire everything we create and build.
about.values.fun.title: Fun First
about.values.fun.desc: We make things that bring joy to the internet.
about.didYouKnow.title: Did you know?
about.didYouKnow.chinese: The Chinese name "索尔幸兹" is a complete transliteration (音译) of "Solsynth".
about.llc.title: About "Solsynth LLC"
about.llc.p1: We used to call ourselves "Solsynth LLC" because it looks prettier in typography.
about.llc.p2: However, since we're not a registered company, the founder quickly realized the legal risk and removed this expression.
about.llc.p3: Please do not use "Solsynth LLC" when referencing us. At least not now.
about.team.title: Meet the Team
about.team.littlesheep.bio: Founder, CEO, CTO, Senior Developer, Marketing Engineer, Customer Service Engineer, DevOps, Database Administrator, Product Manager, UI/UX Designer, QA Engineer, Mobile Developer, Security Engineer, Technical Writer, Project Manager, Community Manager, Software Architect, Cleaner, basically does anything...
about.hiring.title: You?
about.hiring.subtitle: Solsynth is actively looking for new members to join us.
about.hiring.roles: You can be a marketer, engineer, or an artist.
about.hiring.note: Since we're not a real company, we cannot provide any kind of salary for you.
about.hiring.cta: If you're interested in contributing to Solsynth projects in your free time, feel free to contact us at

solarNetwork.tagline: A serene social network that makes self-expression and connecting with others simple and pure.
solarNetwork.about.title: About Solar Network
solarNetwork.about.desc: Solian (also known as Solar Network) is a social platform designed to help you express yourself freely and connect with others. We don't aim to replace any mainstream platforms—we simply offer you another peaceful and harmonious community choice.
solarNetwork.features.title: Powerful Features
solarNetwork.features.desc: From daily social interactions to interest-based communities, Solian provides you with a complete social experience.
solarNetwork.features.timeline.title: Timeline
solarNetwork.features.timeline.desc: View posts in chronological order, never missing a moment. Follow people you're interested in and get their latest updates in real-time.
solarNetwork.features.posts.title: Posts, Articles & Moments
solarNetwork.features.posts.desc: Multiple content types for different expression needs. Short posts, long articles, moment stories—express yourself however you want.
solarNetwork.features.chat.title: Instant Messaging
solarNetwork.features.chat.desc: Real-time chat with group support. Private conversations with friends or create groups for lively discussions with like-minded people.
solarNetwork.features.realms.title: Realms
solarNetwork.features.realms.desc: Interest-based communities to find like-minded people. Each realm is a themed community where you can find friends who share your interests.
solarNetwork.features.oauth.title: OAuth Integration
solarNetwork.features.oauth.desc: Secure third-party authentication for easy login. Multiple login methods supported—no need to remember complicated passwords while keeping your account safe.
solarNetwork.features.checkin.title: Check-in
solarNetwork.features.checkin.desc: Location and status sharing. Daily check-ins not only record your life's journey but also help you discover interesting people and events nearby.
solarNetwork.features.countdown.title: Countdown
solarNetwork.features.countdown.desc: Track special dates and holidays. Set countdowns for important days and never miss another memorable moment.
solarNetwork.features.rss.title: RSS Reader
solarNetwork.features.rss.desc: Subscribe to external news sources and aggregate content you care about. Read all your favorite blogs, news, and website updates in one place.
solarNetwork.features.wallet.title: Wallet
solarNetwork.features.wallet.desc: Points trading system. Earn points by participating in community activities and unlock more fun features and privileges.
solarNetwork.features.stickers.title: Stickers
solarNetwork.features.stickers.desc: Express your unique self with custom stickers. A rich sticker library makes your conversations more lively and fun.
solarNetwork.features.editor.title: Rich Text Editor
solarNetwork.features.editor.desc: Based on Markdown with extended syntax support. Whether you're writing long-form content or simple notes, you'll find it easy to master.
solarNetwork.features.files.title: File Management
solarNetwork.features.files.desc: Upload and manage files. Images, documents, audio, video—all your shared content is properly stored and managed.
solarNetwork.features.social.title: Social Features
solarNetwork.features.social.desc: Friends list and blocklist management. Follow people you like, block content you don't want to see—take full control of your social experience.
solarNetwork.features.fediverse.title: Fediverse
solarNetwork.features.fediverse.desc: Interact with other federated instances and connect to a broader world. Join the Fediverse and communicate with users from Mastodon, Pixel, and other platforms.
solarNetwork.features.achievements.title: Achievements & Progress
solarNetwork.features.achievements.desc: Record every moment of your journey on Solar Network. Unlock various achievements and witness your growth trajectory.
solarNetwork.aboutCard.peaceful.title: Peaceful & Harmonious
solarNetwork.aboutCard.peaceful.desc: A social space away from the noise, letting you focus on what truly matters—connecting with like-minded people. Here you can quietly share your life without worrying about noise and information overload.
solarNetwork.aboutCard.developer.title: Developer Friendly
solarNetwork.aboutCard.developer.desc: If you're a developer, Solar Network has rich tools for you: native syntax highlighting, code snippet sharing, seamless integration with your favorite development tools. Sharing code has never been easier.
solarNetwork.aboutCard.open.title: Open Ecosystem
solarNetwork.aboutCard.open.desc: We provide fully documented APIs, transparent rate limits, and risk controls. Whether building your own client or developing third-party apps, Solar Network is an ideal starting point.
solarNetwork.journey.title: Start Your Journey
solarNetwork.help.title: Need Help?
solarNetwork.help.desc: Feel free to report bugs or contact us on GitHub.

royIcp.intro: **ROY ICP Filling** is an Internet Content Provider (ICP) filing service authorized by the Cyberspace Administration of the Republic of Yang and established by Solsynth. It allows citizens of Yang and other countries to conveniently view websites certified by Solsynth and its partners, improve the content quality of the online world, and support the development of local Internet enterprises in Yang.
